description: This Kotlin source file defines the SyncSettingsFragment class, which manages the user interface for synchronization settings in an Android app. It handles preferences related to cloud services, Nextcloud integration, storage locations, and sync modes, including user interactions and observing preference changes.

classes.name: SyncSettingsFragment
classes.description: A fragment managing synchronization settings, preferences, and user interactions for cloud services and storage locations.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the fragment view, sets up UI components, and preference observers.

methods.name: setupPreferenceObservers
methods.description: Observes preference changes and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: setupLocalLocationListener
methods.description: Sets up click listener for storage location setting.

methods.name: setupNextcloudServerListener
methods.description: Sets up click listener for Nextcloud server setting.

methods.name: setupNextcloudAccountListener
methods.description: Sets up click listener for Nextcloud account setting.

methods.name: setupSyncServiceListener
methods.description: Sets up click listener for cloud service selection.

methods.name: setupSyncModeListener
methods.description: Sets up click listener for sync mode selection.

methods.name: setupBackgroundSyncListener
methods.description: Sets up click listener for background sync setting.

methods.name: setupNewNotesSyncableListener
methods.description: Sets up click listener for new notes sync preference.

methods.name: setupTrustCertificatesListener
methods.description: Sets up click listener for trust self-signed certificates setting.

methods.name: setupClearNextcloudCredentialsListener
methods.description: Sets up click listener to clear Nextcloud credentials.
